description: Declaration of a surface shared between agents: owner, writers, readers and single-writer flag. The library enforces owner-is-a-writer (SSD-1), single-writer consistency (SSD-2) and distinct writer and reader lists (SSD-3, SSD-4); locator uniqueness and runtime writer conformance are consumer-side (SSD-5, SSD-6).

surface_id.description: Stable opaque identifier for this declaration (UUID).

locator.description: Opaque URI or path naming the surface. Not parsed by the library (SSD-N1); uniqueness across declarations is SSD-5, runtime-deferred.

owner_agent_id.description: Agent accountable for the surface. MUST appear in writer_agent_ids (SSD-1).

writer_agent_ids.description: Every agent permitted to write to the surface. Entries are distinct (SSD-3) and include the owner (SSD-1). Runtime writers outside this list are the SSD-6 violation.

items.description: Consumer-shaped agent identifier, compared by exact string equality (SSD-N4).

reader_agent_ids.description: Every agent permitted to read the surface. May be empty. Entries are distinct (SSD-4). No relationship to the writer list is required (SSD-N2, SSD-N3).

items.description: Consumer-shaped agent identifier, compared by exact string equality (SSD-N4).

single_writer.description: True when exactly one agent writes to the surface. When true, writer_agent_ids has exactly one entry (SSD-2).

audit_trail_id.description: Optional opaque pointer to the audit trail that records writes to the surface. Not resolved (SSD-N6).

max_age_ms.description: Maximum age of an entry, in milliseconds.

declared_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC instant (Z suffix, optional 1-9 digit fraction) at which the declaration was made. Offset forms are rejected.

declared_by.description: Actor that made the declaration. Need not be the owner (SSD-N7).

contract_version.description: Hounfour contract version this declaration was authored against.
